units.source_text: 为了接触大海，我要迎着从原野、田间吹拂过来山风再走一程。

en.t: To reach the sea, I had to walk a little farther into the mountain wind blowing across the fields and open plain.
A strong wind swept over the northern sea.

units.source_text: 这般凛冽的风，在渺无人影的原野上如此浪费地劲吹，全然是为了大海。

en.t: Such a bitter wind, blowing so extravagantly across the deserted plain, existed entirely for the sake of the sea.

units.source_text: 可以说，它是覆盖着这地方的冬天的、气体的大海，是命令式的、支配式的、看不见的大海。

en.t: One might say it was the winter covering this place, a sea made of air, an imperative, dominating, invisible sea.
